## Everything you wish your spreadsheet could do

Set tasks and get reminders

Schedule follow-ups linked to your contacts and leads. Get an email every morning with a list of who you need to touch base with.

Timestamp notes and sync emails

Create a clear timeline of interactions for each contact with automatically timestamped notes, and synced emails.

Share notes with your team

Add your team to share notes and collaborate on leads across departments. Restrict or grant access however you'd like.

Integrate with your calendar

Sync up with your Google or Outlook calendar (or both!) so every meeting gets automatically saved in your contacts' profiles.

## Without the overwhelmingcomplexity of other CRMs

01

Built for small businesses, full stop

Every feature is designed with the solo user in mind. No onboarding fees, no setup consultants, no enterprise bloat you'll never touch.

[Try our interactive live demo →](https://account.lessannoyingcrm.com/account/begin_demo.php)

02

$15 per user, per month. That's it.

One price tier. No contracts. No upgrade fees. Honest pricing — because we're self-funded and answerable only to our customers.

[See pricing →](https://lessannoyingcrm.com/pricing)

03

Collaborate with real human experts

Our coaches are product and small business experts with an average tenure of 5+ years. Free for every user, including you, on day one of your trial.

[Contact us →](https://account.lessannoyingcrm.com/contact)

Other CRMs

Less Annoying CRM

Onboarding or setup fees

✕ Often required

✓ Never

Free human support

✕ Paid tiers only

✓ Everyone, always

Long-term contracts

✕ Annual lock-in

✓ Cancel anytime

Data ownership

✕ Difficult to export

✓ Yours to export to Excel whenever

[See how we compare to Pipedrive, Salesforce, and more →](https://lessannoyingcrm.com/comparison)

## We can do this because we're self-funded.

Unlike most CRMs, Less Annoying CRM has been family-owned and self-funded since 2009.

Never raising money from investors, private equity, or venture capitalists means we are never pressured to screw our customers over to "increase shareholder value".

We get to run Less Annoying CRM the way you run your small business, and that's how we like it. 💙

[Read our story](https://lessannoyingcrm.com/about)

Have a name like "Less Annoying CRM"

Price our software as low as we can

Offer great customer support for free

No pressure to target big companies and build complex features

Let every customer fully own their data

## And it's a playbook our customers trust

“

The Less Annoying CRM is very intuitive which allows you to get up and running on the very first day. It keeps me organized and reminds me daily of important follow up tasks and events so that I never miss a beat.

— Sheila O.

“

It is very, very simple to use and that was what I needed. Too many of the other CRMs had long learning curves but I was looking to start running on the first day; that's why I chose Less Annoying CRM.

— Eddie F.

“

I love the fact that I can sync so many things. I can sync to MailChimp and Google Calendar. Very necessary for my business.

— Danielle B.

“

Having all my client data in one place, alerts, lead and process management. I am less likely to miss deadlines and more likely to be proactive.

— Hal W.

“

Keeping in contact with varied businesses and groups can require multiple approaches. LACRM makes organizing simple and effective. Best CRM out there for me.

— Julie L.

“

After trying to subscribe to MS Dynamics which is 10 times or more the price for over two months, I set up with LACRM in less than 5 mins and used all the online videos to implement special requirements.The folks are simply wonderfully helpful!

— Roland W.

Product tour

## See how it works.

[View all features →](https://lessannoyingcrm.com/tour)

ContactsTasksCalendarEmail

01 / Contacts

### Track every relationship, start to close.

Know exactly what your relationship is with every single contact. Full contact history includes notes, follow-ups, meetings, and every email you've ever sent.

[Learn about Contacts →](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/help-topics/contacts-and-companies)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5eb25de94cee6c29635fe867/6983cfa166fd64e07b632d9f_Contact%20Management.svg)

02 / Tasks

### Your daily to-do list, written for you.

Every morning, Less Annoying CRM sends you an email with everything due that day. Stop maintaining a separate task list — your follow-ups live right next to the contacts they belong to.

[Learn about Tasks →](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/help-topics/tasks)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5eb25de94cee6c29635fe867/6983d0a4687472eac679c476_Tasks%20(1).png)

03 / Calendar

### Every meeting, in the same place as your contacts.

Sync with Google or Outlook — or both. Every event gets saved to the right contact's profile automatically, so you always have full context before you pick up the phone.

[Learn about Calendar →](http://lessannoyingcrm.com/help-topics/calendar)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5eb25de94cee6c29635fe867/69836007eaa9277d20cb76af_65fc5bd77a3aea4e682e4a9f_Calendar.png)

04 / Email

### Every email you've ever sent, logged chronologically.

Connect LACRM with your Google or Outlook email inbox, and every email you send and receive automatically slots into your contacts' profile pages. Review all your past email correspondence in one place in the context of all your calls and meetings.

[Learn about Emails →](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/help/log-email-communication-with-a-contact-or-a-company)

![Email logging](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5eb25de94cee6c29635fe867/6983d1605b212e122261d9e8_Email%20Logging%20(1).png)

No credit card required. No setup fees. Real human support from day one — even during your free trial.

Less Annoying CRM was started by two brothers in 2009. Our mission is simple: help small businesses succeed. To do this, we've created a new breed of CRM software.

We focus on giving our customers what they really need, and nothing they don't. That means no annoying buzzwords, no confusing pricing plans, no long-term contracts, and none of those other things that we all know are annoying.
